questions.question: In which of the following states is the festival 'Chapchar Kut' celebrated?
The Konark Sun Temple was built by which king of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Narasimhadeva I.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Konark Sun Temple:**

 
• Konark Sun Temple, **located in the East Odisha near the sacred city of Puri.**
 
• **Built in the 13th century by King Narasimhadeva I **(AD 1238-1264). Its scale, refinement and conception represent the strength and **stability of the Eastern Ganga Empire as well as the value systems of the historic milieu.**
 
• The** Eastern Ganga dynasty also known as Rudhi Gangas or Prachya Gangas.**
 
• It was the large Indian royal dynasty in the medieval era that reigned from Kalinga from as early as the** 5th century to the early 15th century.**
 
• The temple is **designed in the shape of a colossal chariot.**
 
• It is dedicated to the **sun God.**
 
• The Konark temple is widely **known not only for its architectural grandeur** but also for the intricacy and profusion of sculptural work.
 
• It was declared a **UNESCO world heritage site in 1984.**
 
• There are two rows of **12 wheels on each side of the Konark sun temple. **Some say the wheels represent the 24 hours in a day and others say the 12 months.
 
• The **seven horses are said to symbolise the seven days of the week.**
 
• Sailors once called this Sun Temple of Konark, the **Black Pagoda** because it was supposed to **draw ships into the shore and cause shipwrecks.**

questions.question: In which year, the Traditional Forest Dwellers Act was enacted in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2006**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights)** Act, 2006,** is a key piece of forest legislation passed in India on 18 December 2006.**

 
 
• It has also been called the Forest Rights Act, the Tribal Rights Act, the Tribal Bill, and the Tribal Land Act.
 
• The Gram Sabha shall be the authority to initiate the process for determining the nature and extent of individual or community forest rights or both that may be given to the forest-dwelling Scheduled Tribes and other traditional forest dwellers.
 
• The State Government shall constitute a Sub-Divisional Level Committee to examine the resolution passed by the Gram Sabha and prepare the record of forest rights and forward it through the Sub-Divisional Officer to the District Level Committee for a final decision.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sangita Kalanidhi award:

1. It is the highest award in the field of Carnatic music.

2. It is conferred by the Union Ministry of Culture and includes a sum of 10 lakhs.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1 only.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• **The Hindu: **Carnatic vocalist Bombay Jayashri has been selected for the Sangita Kalanidhi award of the Music Academy for 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****Sangita Kalanidhi award:**

 
• It is considered the highest award in the field of **Carnatic music**.*** Hence statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The award is given by the **Madras Music Academy. *Hence statement 2 is not correct.***
 
• The award comprises a **gold medal and a citation **and involves no cash prize
 
• It is a landmark institution in the history of the **fine arts**. It emerged as an **offshoot of the All India Congress Session** held in Madras in December **1927**.

**Carnatic music:**

 
• Carnatic music is commonly associated with southern India including the states of **Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu, but also practiced in Sri Lanka.**
 
• Along with Hindustani music, it becomes one of the two major forms of music developed in India.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of NASA's Ingenuity helicopter on Mars?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NDTV:** NASA Re-Establishes Contact With Ingenuity Helicopter On Mars After Outage. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****Ingenuity helicopter:**

__
 
• Ingenuity is the **first helicopter to fly on Mars.**
 
• It was carried by **NASA’s rover** called** Perseverance** which was launched in July 2020.
 
• Ingenuity can fly using** counter-rotating blades** that spin at about** 2,400 rpm **(Rotations Per Minute).
 
• It has a** wireless communication system, and is equipped with computers, navigation sensors, and two cameras.**
 
• It is **solar-powered** and able to charge on its own.
 
• **The mission of the Helicopter:**
 
 
• The helicopter’s mission is experimental and completely independent of the rover’s science mission.
 
• Its aims to** test powered, controlled flight on another celestial body i.e. Autonomous flight demonstration. Hence, option 2 is correct.**
 
 
 
• **Importance of this Flight:**
 
 
• Its performance during these experimental test flights will help inform decisions about small helicopters for future Mars missions — where they can perform a support role as robotic scouts, surveying terrain from above, or as full standalone science craft carrying instrument payloads.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **NASA’s Perseverance Rover:**

 
• **Perseverance **landed at the **Jezero Crater **(an ancient river delta that has rocks and minerals that could only form in water) of Mars in **February 2021.**
 
• It will remain on the Red Planet for about **two years **and** look for past signs of life.**
 
• The rover is** designed to study signs of ancient life, collect samples that might be sent back to Earth during future missions, and test new technology that might benefit future robotic and human missions to the planet.**

questions.question: Which armed force is leading Operation Sarvashakti?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Indian Army**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Operation Sarvashakti: Indian Army to eliminate terrorists in J&K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Operation Sarvashakti,** launched by **Indian Army to eradicate terrorists** in Rajouri and Poonch areas.
 
• The motto of launching this operation is to counteract the resurgence of terrorism orchestrated by Pakistani proxy groups along the Pir Panjal mountain ranges in the Union Territory.
 
• Large-scale operation reminiscent of 2003's Sarpvinash to counter ambushes on Indian troops.
 
• The operation will be conducted by the Srinagar-headquartered 15 Corps and Nagrota-based 16 Corps of the Indian Army.
